In detail

Everything Catania is visited for is here — piazza Duomo, via Etnea, piazza Università, piazza Stesicoro, the Villa Bellini gardens, the Teatro Massimo — and so is San Berillo, immediately behind it. The Prefettura's zone rosse ordinance covered six central areas including Duomo, Università, Bellini, Stesicoro and Villa Bellini, and its stated grounds were illegal parking attendants, unauthorised street commerce and a high incidence of predatory crime, singling out the area near San Berillo. Police anti-degrado operations through 2026 repeatedly named San Berillo and San Cristoforo, both of which fall inside this same municipalità. The baroque streets and the movida are busy and workable; the blocks behind the station end of via Etnea are not the same place after dark.
